# CivInt Canada — API & Documentation Index

> CivInt Canada is Canada's sovereign, AI-native government data layer: one REST + MCP API for
> government datasets (StatCan, open.canada.ca, federal spending, provincial portals) with built-in
> AI curation, SHA-256 verification, and provenance audit trails.

- **Base URL:** https://api.civint.ca/v1/
- **OpenAPI Spec:** /v1/openapi.json
- **MCP Server:** `npx @civint/mcp-server` (stdio/SSE transport)
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/reverb256/frostbite-data-pipeline
- **License:** Attribution required. Government data under OGL-C.

---

## API Endpoints

- `/v1/health` — Health check
- `/v1/gov/releases` — Government data releases
- `/v1/gov/search` — Search datasets by keyword/jurisdiction
- `/v1/citation/:hash` — Verify SHA-256 citation hash
- `/v1/usage` — View usage/quotas
- `/v1/audit/query` — Query audit logs (Business tier+)

## MCP Tools

- `query_gov_data` — Query government data (query, jurisdiction, category, limit)
- `fact_check` — Check a claim against government data (claim)
- `get_citation` — Retrieve/verify citation hash (hash)
- `latest_releases` — Latest government data releases (jurisdiction, category, limit)
